finding: Header-only reset leaves stale production data
evidence: Sync-BasketsToOneDrive.ps1:39-46 requires a first data row even though the EA creates a header immediately on a new run.
impact: The old OneDrive Baskets.csv remains visible until the first new basket closes, so Excel can report a prior run as current.
required_fix: Accept an exact schema-v3 header-only file using the configured expected login and atomically publish it as an empty current snapshot.

finding: Scheduled tasks can store an unusable relative config path
evidence: Install-BasketsSyncTask.ps1:11-18 quotes ConfigPath without resolving it; the setup guide installs with .\accounts.csv.
impact: The manual copy can pass during installation while the later scheduled task starts in another working directory and cannot find its configuration.
required_fix: Resolve script and config to validated absolute paths and set or avoid reliance on the task working directory.

finding: Enabled-account failures still report process success
evidence: Sync-BasketsToOneDrive.ps1:141-165 converts failures into result rows and formats them; it does not throw or exit nonzero after an account error.
impact: Task Scheduler can show a successful run when no current CSV was delivered, preventing reliable alerting and retry policy.
required_fix: Return a nonzero exit code when any enabled account is Error or an integrity-related Skip, while preserving a machine-readable run summary.

finding: Copy consistency and final publication are not atomic
evidence: Sync-BasketsToOneDrive.ps1:116-135 takes a fresh zero-second stability snapshot after copying instead of comparing pre-copy and post-copy metadata, then uses File.Copy to overwrite the live destination.
impact: An MT4 append during the copy can produce an inconsistent snapshot, and OneDrive or Excel can observe a partially overwritten destination.
required_fix: Capture and compare source metadata or digest across the copy, validate the temporary file, then use an atomic same-volume replace/move.

finding: CSV validation covers only four header names and the first row
evidence: Sync-BasketsToOneDrive.ps1:29-46 does not validate all rows; Test-MoneyMachineCsvSync.ps1:33-36 appends a non-CSV comment line and still expects a successful copy.
impact: Malformed rows, mixed accounts, wrong schema values, missing keys, or duplicate basket keys can enter the dashboard unnoticed.
required_fix: Parse the complete copied file and enforce schema/order, field count, version, account consistency, key completeness/uniqueness, types, and controlled values.

finding: Daily and logon tasks can overlap and race on shared state
evidence: Install-BasketsSyncTask.ps1:24-28 creates two independent tasks; Sync-BasketsToOneDrive.ps1:49-68 and 158 directly read/write one shared success-state file without a cross-process lock or atomic replace.
impact: Concurrent runs can lose success markers, interleave logs, or race while publishing the same account destination.
required_fix: Use a named mutex or lock file across both tasks and atomically replace state after a complete run.

finding: Configuration fingerprint omits 12 of 37 configuration inputs
evidence: MoneyMachine_Baskets.m:20 includes 25 fields but omits FixedLots, five detailed regime settings, the trading-days enable flag, and Monday-Friday flags.
impact: Runs with materially different trading configurations can receive the same fingerprint and be compared as if their setup were identical.
required_fix: Build the fingerprint from all 37 configuration fields in a stable documented order with culture-invariant formatting.

finding: Success confirms only a local copy, not cloud delivery or report freshness
evidence: Sync-BasketsToOneDrive.ps1:147-150 marks success immediately after the local overwrite; logging at lines 13-19 has no rotation, heartbeat, cloud-state check, or alert output.
impact: Paused, signed-out, quota-full, or offline OneDrive can leave the cloud and Excel stale while local runs continue to say Success; sync.log grows without bound.
required_fix: Define a freshness SLO, emit per-account source/destination timestamps and row counts, rotate logs, and monitor an end-to-end heartbeat or OneDrive sync state.

finding: Excel delivery is a manual setup and refresh step
evidence: The workbook package contains no external connection; CSV_ONEDRIVE_EXCEL_SETUP.md:49-57 instructs the operator to paste M code and use Refresh All.
impact: The current deliverable is not an end-to-end automated reporting pipeline and can remain stale even when OneDrive is current.
required_fix: Either document this explicitly as an accepted manual control or ship a prewired, tested query plus a defined refresh/ownership procedure.

finding: Installer assumes a Windows PowerShell executable without a runtime preflight
evidence: Install-BasketsSyncTask.ps1:13 constructs $PSHOME\powershell.exe and lines 17-18 register it without checking that the executable exists or the required ScheduledTasks cmdlets are available.
impact: Installation from PowerShell 7 or an unexpected host can register a task whose executable path is invalid or unsupported.
required_fix: Declare the supported runtime, resolve the executable with Get-Command or the current process path, and fail installation if prerequisites are missing.

finding: Upstream CSV text fields are not escaped
evidence: AmmarTradingGoldEA V3.mq4:1620-1681 concatenates BrokerName, Symbol, and other text directly into a comma-separated line.
impact: A comma, quote, or newline in a broker-provided text field can shift columns or corrupt a row before the sync validator sees it.
required_fix: Use a tested CSV-escaping helper for every text field and add fixtures containing commas, quotes, and line breaks.
